title: Halves and quarters
subject: Maths
objectives: Say what a half and a quarter of a whole shape are.
Find half and a quarter of a small number of objects.
Know that two quarters make one half.

blocks.text: When we cut something into parts that are all the same size, we call them equal parts. A fraction tells us how many equal parts we are talking about.

blocks.alt: A round roti cut into two equal pieces
blocks.caption: One roti, two equal parts.

blocks.definition: Parts of one whole that are exactly the same size.

blocks.text: If a whole is cut into 2 equal parts, each part is one half. We write one half as 1/2.

blocks.title: Sharing a chapati
blocks.text: Ali and Sara share one chapati equally. Each of them gets one half of the chapati.
To find half of a number of things, share them into 2 equal groups.

items: Make 2 groups and put one mango in each group at a time.

blocks.text: If a whole is cut into 4 equal parts, each part is one quarter. We write one quarter as 1/4.

blocks.alt: A square cut into four equal smaller squares, one shaded
blocks.caption: One of the four equal parts is shaded: that is one quarter.

items: A quarter is smaller than a half.

blocks.title: A quarter of 12 pencils
blocks.text: Share 12 pencils into 4 equal groups. Each group has 3 pencils, so a quarter of 12 is 3.

questions.explanation: Share 10 into 2 equal groups: each group has 5.

questions.prompt: A pizza is cut into 4 equal slices. What is one slice called?
questions.explanation: One of 4 equal parts is one quarter.
1/4 and 1/4 together are 2/4, which is the same as 1/2.

questions.prompt: A roti broken into one big piece and one small piece is cut into halves.
questions.explanation: Halves must be equal parts. A big piece and a small piece are not equal.
Share 8 into 4 equal groups: each group has 2.

terms.definition: The complete thing before it is cut or shared.
One of 2 equal parts of a whole. Written 1/2.
One of 4 equal parts of a whole. Written 1/4.
A number that tells us about equal parts of a whole.

summary: A half is one of 2 equal parts and a quarter is one of 4 equal parts. To find half or a quarter of some things, share them into 2 or 4 equal groups. Two quarters make one half.
